name: Brother Aldric

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.description: A righteous strike that channels divine wrath through the weapon

abilities.name: Healing Word
abilities.description: Speaks a prayer that mends wounds from a distance

abilities.name: Turn Undead
abilities.description: Presents holy symbol to drive back unholy creatures

appearance.hair: short-cropped brown with gray at temples
appearance.distinctive_features: Battle scar across right cheek, holy symbol branded into left forearm, military posture

personality.demeanor: Stern and authoritative like a veteran soldier, shows kindness to the faithful but suspicion toward outsiders
personality.speaking_style: Clipped military cadence, mixes prayer fragments with battlefield terminology, speaks commands not suggestions

beliefs: Faith and steel together serve divine justice
All life deserves protection, but not all beings deserve trust
Discipline and order prevent chaos and suffering
philosophy.approach_to_conflict: Meets threats with controlled aggression. Fights with tactical precision, viewing combat as sacred duty. Will demand surrender before striking but shows no mercy to those who refuse. Distrusts elven magic as deceptive compared to honest steel and divine power. Will heal enemies who yield, but only after securing them.

visible: War hammer with prayers etched on head
Large wooden shield with holy symbol
hidden: Small healer's kit (considers it weakness to display openly)
Letter from his deceased wife, worn from repeated reading

secrets: Wife and daughter died from plague despite his prayers and what healing he knew
Blames elven traders for bringing the disease that destroyed his village
Doubts his faith but continues his holy warrior's path because it's all he knows
backstory: A village militiaman who joined a crusading order after plague claimed his family. He blamed the elven merchants whose caravan had passed through days before. Rose to become a war-priest, combining martial skill with divine magic. Now wanders as a holy warrior for hire, seeking purpose through righteous violence while nursing his hatred of elves.
